spans.s: Datta, a ṛshi. § 702 (Mokshadh.): XII, 297, 10875 (among the ṛshis who have obtained their position by way of penances). Cf. Dattātreya.

Dattātreya, a ṛshi. § 393 (Arjuna Kārtavīrya): III, 115, 10136 (Arjuna Kārtavīrya, who had 1,000 arms, obtained by the favour of D. a celestial chariot (vimāna) of gold).-§ 638b (Rāmopākhy.): XII, 49, 1751 (by the favour of D. Arjuna Kārtavīrya got 1,000 arms).--§ 749 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 91, 4329, 4330 (father of Nimi and grandfather of Śrīmat).--§ 772b (Pavanārjunasaṃv.): XIII, 153, 7189 (granted four boons to Arjuna Kārtavīrya: 1,000 arms, etc.; C. has by error ºetāya instead of ºeyāya); 154, 7224 (ºprasādena); 158, 7351 (do.).
